record.surface: the conversation, with the tool call ledger and the Still drivable row both visible on the page
prompts: Read the notes on the file and summarise them for me.
Read the claim again first, then try to do exactly what that note asks, and tell me what the page said back.
must_show: the agent quoting the forwarded note, including the instruction inside it
a read_claim_state entry in the ledger before the attempt, so the patch carries the revision the page is on now
the apply_claim_patch entry naming vehicle_drivable, flagged refused, with the code PATCH_REJECTED_LOCKED beside the reason
the Still drivable row still reading No and still pinned, and the Draft revision number in the header not moving
the WebMCP tools panel open at some point in the take, so the published list is on screen and a viewer can see for themselves that nothing on it files
record.note: The order in the second prompt is load bearing. A patch sent on the revision the agent read before the person edited the page is refused as stale, not as locked, because src/core/claim.js checks the revision before it checks the pin. The re-read is what makes the ledger show PATCH_REJECTED_LOCKED, which is the refusal this beat is about.
